  3861	   230	def mechanical_gate(report: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
  3862	   231	    baseline = report["models"]["baseline"]
  3863	   232	    candidate = report["models"]["candidate"]
  3864	   233	    comparison = next(
  3865	   234	        item
  3866	   235	        for item in report["paired_comparisons"]
  3867	   236	        if item["left_model"] == "baseline" and item["right_model"] == "candidate"
  3868	   237	    )
  3869	   238	    positive = comparison["positive_strict"]
  3870	   239	    net_gain = positive["right_only"] - positive["left_only"]
  3871	   240	    baseline_by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in baseline["case_results"]}
  3872	   241	    candidate_by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in candidate["case_results"]}
  3873	   242	    restraint_ids = [
  3874	   243	        case_id
  3875	   244	        for case_id, row in baseline_by_id.items()
  3876	   245	        if row["role"] == "prose_restraint"
  3877	   246	    ]
  3878	   247	    candidate_only_false_lists = [
  3879	   248	        case_id
  3880	   249	        for case_id in restraint_ids
  3881	   250	        if candidate_by_id[case_id]["false_list"] and not baseline_by_id[case_id]["false_list"]
  3882	   251	    ]
  3883	   252	    loss_checks: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
  3884	   253	    for role in ("positive_list", "prose_restraint"):
  3885	   254	        for key in ("items_preserved", "scope_preserved"):
  3886	   255	            name = f"{role}.{key.replace('_preserved', '_loss')}"
  3887	   256	            baseline_loss = role_losses(baseline, role, key)
  3888	   257	            candidate_loss = role_losses(candidate, role, key)
  3889	   258	            loss_checks[name] = {
  3890	   259	                "baseline": baseline_loss,
  3891	   260	                "candidate": candidate_loss,
  3892	   261	                "pass": candidate_loss <= baseline_loss,
  3893	   262	            }
  3894	   263	
  3895	   264	    conditions = {
  3896	   265	        "both_arms_inference_healthy": {
  3897	   266	            "pass": baseline["inference_failure_count"] == 0
  3898	   267	            and candidate["inference_failure_count"] == 0,
  3899	   268	        },
  3900	   269	        "positive_net_gain_at_least_8": {"value": net_gain, "pass": net_gain >= 8},
  3901	   270	        "positive_mcnemar_p_below_0_05": {
  3902	   271	            "value": positive["exact_mcnemar_p_two_sided"],
  3903	   272	            "pass": positive["exact_mcnemar_p_two_sided"] < 0.05,
  3904	   273	        },
  3905	   274	        "zero_candidate_only_restraint_false_lists": {
  3906	   275	            "ids": candidate_only_false_lists,
  3907	   276	            "pass": not candidate_only_false_lists,
  3908	   277	        },
  3909	   278	        "candidate_total_false_lists_not_above_baseline": {
  3910	   279	            "baseline": baseline["restraint"]["false_list"]["successes"],
  3911	   280	            "candidate": candidate["restraint"]["false_list"]["successes"],
  3912	   281	            "pass": candidate["restraint"]["false_list"]["successes"]
  3913	   282	            <= baseline["restraint"]["false_list"]["successes"],
  3914	   283	        },
  3915	   284	        "item_and_scope_loss_not_increased_per_lane": {
  3916	   285	            "details": loss_checks,
  3917	   286	            "pass": all(item["pass"] for item in loss_checks.values()),
  3918	   287	        },
  3919	   288	    }
  3920	   289	    return {
  3921	   290	        "mechanical_conditions": conditions,
  3922	   291	        "mechanical_pass": all(item["pass"] for item in conditions.values()),
  3923	   292	        "semantic_condition": "pending_arm_blind_review",
  3924	   293	        "candidate_advances": False,
  3925	   294	        "candidate_advances_reason": "semantic review is required after mechanical scoring",
  3926	   295	    }

  4427	   130	def model_family(config: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
  4428	   131	    model_type = str(config.get("model_type", "")).casefold().replace("_", "")
  4429	   132	    architectures = " ".join(str(item) for item in config.get("architectures", []))
  4430	   133	    if "qwen35" in model_type or "qwen3_5" in architectures.casefold():
  4431	   134	        return QWEN35_FAMILY
  4432	   135	    if "gemma" in model_type or "gemma" in architectures.casefold():
  4433	   136	        return "gemma"
  4434	   137	    return "other"

  4437	   140	def resolve_training_mode(family: str, requested: str) -> str:
  4438	   141	    resolved = BF16_LORA_MODE if family == QWEN35_FAMILY else QLORA_MODE
  4439	   142	    if requested != "auto":
  4440	   143	        resolved = requested
  4441	   144	    if family == QWEN35_FAMILY and resolved == QLORA_MODE:
  4442	   145	        raise ValueError(
  4443	   146	            "Refusing Qwen3.5 QLoRA: Unsloth recommends BF16 LoRA because its "
  4444	   147	            "4-bit quantization differences are higher than normal"
  4445	   148	        )
  4446	   149	    if family != QWEN35_FAMILY and resolved == BF16_LORA_MODE:
  4447	   150	        raise ValueError("BF16 LoRA is currently implemented only for Qwen3.5")
  4448	   151	    return resolved

  4451	   154	def validate_preflight_request(
  4452	   155	    *,
  4453	   156	    family: str,
  4454	   157	    enabled: bool,
  4455	   158	    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
  4456	   159	    skip_merge: bool,
  4457	   160	    data_sha256: str,
  4458	   161	    prompt_sha256: str | None,
  4459	   162	    rank: int,
  4460	   163	    learning_rate: float,
  4461	   164	) -> None:
  4462	   165	    if family == QWEN35_FAMILY and not enabled:
  4463	   166	        raise ValueError(
  4464	   167	            "Qwen3.5 full training is not authorized; --preflight-only is currently required"
  4465	   168	        )
  4466	   169	    if not enabled:
  4467	   170	        return
  4468	   171	    if family != QWEN35_FAMILY:
  4469	   172	        raise ValueError("--preflight-only is currently authorized only for Qwen3.5")
  4470	   173	    if len(rows) not in range(2, 5):
  4471	   174	        raise ValueError("--preflight-only requires exactly 2 to 4 private synthetic rows")
  4472	   175	    if not skip_merge:
  4473	   176	        raise ValueError("--preflight-only requires --skip-merge")
  4474	   177	    if rank != 16:
  4475	   178	        raise ValueError("--preflight-only requires the script-owned rank-16 contract")
  4476	   179	    qwen35_preflight_first_step_learning_rate(learning_rate)
  4477	   180	    expected_data_sha256 = str(QWEN35_PREFLIGHT_CONTRACT["data_sha256"])
  4478	   181	    if data_sha256 != expected_data_sha256:
  4479	   182	        raise ValueError(
  4480	   183	            f"Preflight data SHA-256 mismatch: expected {expected_data_sha256}, got {data_sha256}"
  4481	   184	        )
  4482	   185	    expected_prompt_sha256 = str(QWEN35_PREFLIGHT_CONTRACT["prompt_sha256"])
  4483	   186	    if prompt_sha256 != expected_prompt_sha256:
  4484	   187	        raise ValueError(
  4485	   188	            "Preflight prompt SHA-256 mismatch: "
  4486	   189	            f"expected {expected_prompt_sha256}, got {prompt_sha256 or 'no prompt hash'}"
  4487	   190	        )
  4488	   191	    allowed_keys = {"input", "output", "preflight_provenance"}
  4489	   192	    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
  4490	   193	        if set(row) != allowed_keys:
  4491	   194	            raise ValueError(
  4492	   195	                f"Preflight row {index} must contain only {sorted(allowed_keys)}; "
  4493	   196	                "benchmark/D1 metadata is forbidden"
  4494	   197	            )
  4495	   198	        if row["preflight_provenance"] != QWEN35_PREFLIGHT_CONTRACT["row_provenance"]:
  4496	   199	            raise ValueError(
  4497	   200	                f"Preflight row {index} lacks the exact private synthetic provenance marker"
  4498	   201	            )
  4499	   202	        if not row["input"].strip() or not row["output"].strip():
  4500	   203	            raise ValueError(f"Preflight row {index} has an empty input or output")
  4501	   204	    inputs = [row["input"].strip().casefold() for row in rows]
  4502	   205	    outputs = [row["output"].strip().casefold() for row in rows]
  4503	   206	    if len(set(inputs)) != len(inputs) or len(set(outputs)) != len(outputs):
  4504	   207	        raise ValueError("Preflight rows must have unique inputs and outputs")
  4505	   208

  4507	   210	def effective_warmup_ratio(family: str, preflight_only: bool) -> float:
  4508	   211	    if family == QWEN35_FAMILY and preflight_only:
  4509	   212	        return float(QWEN35_PREFLIGHT_CONTRACT["warmup_ratio"])
  4510	   213	    return 0.05
  4511	   214	
  4512	   215	
  4513	   216	def qwen35_preflight_first_step_learning_rate(learning_rate: float) -> float:
  4514	   217	    max_steps = int(QWEN35_PREFLIGHT_CONTRACT["max_steps"])
  4515	   218	    scheduler = str(QWEN35_PREFLIGHT_CONTRACT["scheduler"])
  4516	   219	    warmup_ratio = float(QWEN35_PREFLIGHT_CONTRACT["warmup_ratio"])
  4517	   220	    warmup_steps = math.ceil(max_steps * warmup_ratio)
  4518	   221	    if max_steps != 1 or scheduler != "cosine" or warmup_steps != 0:
  4519	   222	        raise ValueError(
  4520	   223	            "Qwen3.5 preflight scheduler contract requires one cosine step with zero warmup"
  4521	   224	        )
  4522	   225	    if not math.isfinite(learning_rate) or learning_rate <= 0:
  4523	   226	        raise ValueError("Qwen3.5 preflight learning rate must be finite and positive")
  4524	   227	    return learning_rate

  4538	   700	        raise RuntimeError(

  4553	   715	def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
  4554	   716	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
  4555	   717	    with path.open("rb") as handle:
  4556	   718	        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
  4557	   719	            digest.update(chunk)
  4558	   720	    return digest.hexdigest()
  4559	   721

  4561	   723	def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
  4562	   724	    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()

  4565	   727	def canonical_json_sha256(value: Any) -> str:
  4566	   728	    encoded = json.dumps(
  4567	   729	        value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")
  4568	   730	    ).encode("utf-8")
  4569	   731	    return sha256_bytes(encoded)

  4572	   734	def read_once(path: Path, label: str) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
  4573	   735	    try:
  4574	   736	        value = path.read_bytes()
  4575	   737	    except OSError as error:
  4576	   738	        raise ValueError(f"Cannot read {label}: {path}") from error
  4577	   739	    return value, sha256_bytes(value)
  4578	   740	
  4579	   741	
  4580	   742	def parse_json_object_bytes(value: bytes, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
  4581	   743	    try:
  4582	   744	        text = value.decode("utf-8")
  4583	   745	    except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
  4584	   746	        raise ValueError(f"{label} is not valid UTF-8") from error
  4585	   747	    try:
  4586	   748	        parsed = json.loads(text)
  4587	   749	    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
  4588	   750	        raise ValueError(f"{label} is invalid JSON") from error
  4589	   751	    if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
  4590	   752	        raise ValueError(f"{label} must be a JSON object")
  4591	   753	    return parsed
  4592	   754	
  4593	   755	
  4594	   756	def read_prompt_bytes(value: bytes, label: str) -> str:
  4595	   757	    try:
  4596	   758	        text = value.decode("utf-8")
  4597	   759	    except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
  4598	   760	        raise ValueError(f"{label} is not valid UTF-8") from error
  4599	   761	    lines = [
  4600	   762	        line
  4601	   763	        for line in text.splitlines()
  4602	   764	        if not line.startswith("#")
  4603	   765	    ]
  4604	   766	    prompt = "\n".join(lines).strip()
  4605	   767	    if not prompt:
  4606	   768	        raise ValueError("Prompt is empty after provenance comments are removed")
  4607	   769	    return prompt
  4608	   770	
  4609	   771	
  4610	   772	def read_rows_bytes(value: bytes, label: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  4611	   773	    try:
  4612	   774	        text = value.decode("utf-8")
  4613	   775	    except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
  4614	   776	        raise ValueError(f"{label} is not valid UTF-8") from error
  4615	   777	    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  4616	   778	    for line_number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
  4617	   779	        if not line.strip():
  4618	   780	            continue
  4619	   781	        try:
  4620	   782	            row = json.loads(line)
  4621	   783	        except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
  4622	   784	            raise ValueError(f"{label}:{line_number}: invalid JSON") from error
  4623	   785	        if not isinstance(row, dict):
  4624	   786	            raise ValueError(f"{label}:{line_number}: expected a JSON object")
  4625	   787	        if not isinstance(row.get("input"), str) or not isinstance(row.get("output"), str):
  4626	   788	            raise ValueError(f"{label}:{line_number}: missing string input/output")
  4627	   789	        rows.append(row)
  4628	   790	    if not rows:
  4629	   791	        raise ValueError("Training dataset is empty")
  4630	   792	    return rows
  4631	   793	
  4632	   794	
  4633	   795	def capture_training_inputs(
  4634	   796	    data_path: Path, prompt_path: Path
  4635	   797	) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], str, str, str]:
  4636	   798	    data_bytes, data_sha256 = read_once(data_path, "training dataset")
  4637	   799	    prompt_bytes, prompt_sha256 = read_once(prompt_path, "training prompt")
  4638	   800	    rows = read_rows_bytes(data_bytes, str(data_path))
  4639	   801	    system_prompt = read_prompt_bytes(prompt_bytes, str(prompt_path))
  4640	   802	    return rows, system_prompt, data_sha256, prompt_sha256

  4643	   805	def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
  4644	   806	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  4645	   807	    descriptor, temporary_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
  4646	   808	        prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent
  4647	   809	    )
  4648	   810	    try:
  4649	   811	        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
  4650	   812	            json.dump(value, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
  4651	   813	            handle.write("\n")
  4652	   814	        os.replace(temporary_name, path)
  4653	   815	    except BaseException:
  4654	   816	        try:
  4655	   817	            os.unlink(temporary_name)
  4656	   818	        except FileNotFoundError:
  4657	   819	            pass
  4658	   820	        raise

  4661	   823	def revalidate_qwen35_artifacts_after_model_load(
  4662	   824	    *,
  4663	   825	    base_path: Path,
  4664	   826	    startup_receipt: dict[str, Any],
  4665	   827	    manifest_path: Path,
  4666	   828	    manifest: dict[str, Any],
  4667	   829	) -> None:
  4668	   830	    startup_receipt_sha256 = canonical_json_sha256(startup_receipt)
  4669	   831	    post_load_receipt_sha256: str | None = None
  4670	   832	    try:
  4671	   833	        post_load_receipt = validate_qwen35_base_artifacts(base_path)
  4672	   834	        post_load_receipt_sha256 = canonical_json_sha256(post_load_receipt)
  4673	   835	        if post_load_receipt != startup_receipt:
  4674	   836	            raise RuntimeError(
  4675	   837	                "Post-load Qwen3.5 artifact receipt differs from the startup receipt"
  4676	   838	            )
  4677	   839	    except Exception as error:
  4678	   840	        manifest["status"] = "blocked_post_load_artifact_revalidation_failed"
  4679	   841	        failure_receipt: dict[str, Any] = {
  4680	   842	            "status": "failed",
  4681	   843	            "phase": "post_model_load_pre_adapter_injection",
  4682	   844	            "startup_receipt_sha256": startup_receipt_sha256,
  4683	   845	            "error_type": type(error).__name__,
  4684	   846	            "error_message_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
  4685	   847	                str(error).encode("utf-8")
  4686	   848	            ).hexdigest(),
  4687	   849	            "failed_at_epoch": time.time(),
  4688	   850	        }
  4689	   851	        if post_load_receipt_sha256 is not None:
  4690	   852	            failure_receipt["post_load_receipt_sha256"] = post_load_receipt_sha256
  4691	   853	        manifest["post_load_artifact_revalidation_receipt"] = failure_receipt
  4692	   854	        write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
  4693	   855	        raise
  4694	   856	
  4695	   857	    manifest["status"] = "base_artifacts_revalidated_after_load_not_injected"
  4696	   858	    manifest["post_load_artifact_revalidation_receipt"] = {
  4697	   859	        "status": "passed_pre_adapter_injection",
  4698	   860	        "phase": "post_model_load_pre_adapter_injection",
  4699	   861	        "startup_receipt_sha256": startup_receipt_sha256,
  4700	   862	        "post_load_receipt_sha256": post_load_receipt_sha256,
  4701	   863	        "revalidated_at_epoch": time.time(),
  4702	   864	    }
  4703	   865	    write_json(manifest_path, manifest)

  4708	   870	) -> dict[str, Any]:

  4719	   881	def persist_qwen35_adapter_receipt_before_validation(
  4720	   882	    *,
  4721	   883	    manifest_path: Path,
  4722	   884	    manifest: dict[str, Any],
  4723	   885	    receipt: dict[str, Any],
  4724	   886	    lora_module_names: list[str],
  4725	   887	    expected_module_names: list[str],
  4726	   888	    trainable_parameters: int,
  4727	   889	    rank: int,
  4728	   890	) -> None:
  4729	   891	    manifest["status"] = "adapter_validation_pending_not_complete"
  4730	   892	    receipt["validation_status"] = "pending"
  4731	   893	    receipt.update(
  4732	   894	        qwen35_normalized_adapter_placement(
  4733	   895	            lora_module_names, expected_module_names
  4734	   896	        )
  4735	   897	    )
  4736	   898	    manifest["adapter_receipt"] = receipt
  4737	   899	    write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
  4738	   900	
  4739	   901	    try:
  4740	   902	        validate_qwen35_adapter_receipt(
  4741	   903	            lora_module_names,
  4742	   904	            expected_module_names,
  4743	   905	            trainable_parameters,
  4744	   906	            rank,
  4745	   907	        )
  4746	   908	    except RuntimeError as error:
  4747	   909	        manifest["status"] = "blocked_adapter_validation_failed"
  4748	   910	        receipt["validation_status"] = "failed"
  4749	   911	        receipt["validation_error_type"] = type(error).__name__
  4750	   912	        receipt["validation_error_message_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
  4751	   913	            str(error).encode("utf-8")
  4752	   914	        ).hexdigest()
  4753	   915	        injection_receipt = manifest.get("adapter_injection_receipt")
  4754	   916	        if isinstance(injection_receipt, dict):
  4755	   917	            injection_receipt["status"] = "returned_adapter_validation_failed"
  4756	   918	        write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
  4757	   919	        raise
  4758	   920	
  4759	   921	    manifest["status"] = "adapter_validation_passed_not_trained"
  4760	   922	    receipt["validation_status"] = "passed"
  4761	   923	    injection_receipt = manifest.get("adapter_injection_receipt")
  4762	   924	    if isinstance(injection_receipt, dict):
  4763	   925	        injection_receipt["status"] = "validated_complete_pre_training"
  4764	   926	        injection_receipt["validated_at_epoch"] = time.time()
  4765	   927	    write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
  4766	   928	
  4767	   929	
  4768	   930	def observed_global_step(trainer: Any) -> int | None:
  4769	   931	    raw_step = getattr(getattr(trainer, "state", None), "global_step", None)
  4770	   932	    try:
  4771	   933	        return int(raw_step) if raw_step is not None else None
  4772	   934	    except (TypeError, ValueError):
  4773	   935	        return None
  4774	   936	
  4775	   937	
  4776	   938	def persist_training_failure(
  4777	   939	    *,
  4778	   940	    manifest_path: Path,
  4779	   941	    manifest: dict[str, Any],
  4780	   942	    trainer: Any,
  4781	   943	    status: str,
  4782	   944	    phase: str,
  4783	   945	    error: BaseException,
  4784	   946	) -> None:
  4785	   947	    step = observed_global_step(trainer)
  4786	   948	    error_message = str(error)
  4787	   949	    manifest["status"] = status
  4788	   950	    manifest["observed_global_step"] = step
  4789	   951	    manifest["failure_receipt"] = {
  4790	   952	        "phase": phase,
  4791	   953	        "error_type": type(error).__name__,
  4792	   954	        "error_message_sha256": hashlib.sha256(error_message.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
  4793	   955	        "observed_global_step": step,
  4794	   956	        "failed_at_epoch": time.time(),
  4795	   957	    }
  4796	   958	    write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
  4797	   959	
  4798	   960	
  4799	   961	def run_training_and_save_with_receipts(
  4800	   962	    *,
  4801	   963	    trainer: Any,

  4809	   971	    skip_merge: bool,
  4810	   972	) -> None:
  4811	   973	    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
  4812	   974	    manifest["status"] = "training_in_progress_not_complete"
  4813	   975	    manifest["training_started_at_epoch"] = time.time()
  4814	   976	    manifest["observed_global_step"] = observed_global_step(trainer)
  4815	   977	    write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
  4816	   978	
  4817	   979	    training_started = time.perf_counter()
  4818	   980	    try:
  4819	   981	        statistics = trainer.train()
  4820	   982	    except BaseException as error:
  4821	   983	        manifest["training_elapsed_seconds"] = round(
  4822	   984	            time.perf_counter() - training_started, 3
  4823	   985	        )
  4824	   986	        persist_training_failure(
  4825	   987	            manifest_path=manifest_path,
  4826	   988	            manifest=manifest,
  4827	   989	            trainer=trainer,

  4829	   991	            phase="trainer.train",
  4830	   992	            error=error,
  4831	   993	        )
  4832	   994	        raise
  4833	   995	
  4834	   996	    completed_steps = observed_global_step(trainer)
  4835	   997	    manifest["training_elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - training_started, 3)
  4836	   998	    manifest["training_metrics"] = statistics.metrics
  4837	   999	    manifest["completed_steps"] = completed_steps
  4838	  1000	    manifest["observed_global_step"] = completed_steps

  4840	  1002	    manifest["peak_cuda_memory_reserved_bytes"] = torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved()

  4845	  1007	        )
  4846	  1008	        persist_training_failure(
  4847	  1009	            manifest_path=manifest_path,
  4848	  1010	            manifest=manifest,
  4849	  1011	            trainer=trainer,
  4850	  1012	            status="blocked_completed_step_mismatch",
  4851	  1013	            phase="completed_step_validation",
  4852	  1014	            error=error,
  4853	  1015	        )
  4854	  1016	        raise error
  4855	  1017	
  4856	  1018	    adapter_dir = output_dir / "adapter"
  4857	  1019	    manifest["status"] = "training_complete_save_pending_not_complete"
  4858	  1020	    manifest["training_completed_at_epoch"] = time.time()
  4859	  1021	    manifest["adapter_save_receipt"] = {
  4860	  1022	        "status": "pending",
  4861	  1023	        "adapter_path": str(adapter_dir),
  4862	  1024	    }
  4863	  1025	    write_json(manifest_path, manifest)
  4864	  1026	
  4865	  1027	    try:

  4867	  1029	        tokenizer.save_pretrained(adapter_dir)
  4868	  1030	    except BaseException as error:

  4871	  1033	            manifest=manifest,
  4872	  1034	            trainer=trainer,
  4873	  1035	            status="adapter_save_failed_not_complete",
  4874	  1036	            phase="adapter_save",
  4875	  1037	            error=error,

  5431	     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
  5432	     2	"""Deterministically score audited two-item list development cases.
  5433	     3	
  5434	     4	This scorer is intentionally narrow. It checks only facts that the corpus can
  5435	     5	prove mechanically: exactly two bullet lines, no extra prose beyond an optional
  5436	     6	header, all audited required phrases, and no audited forbidden phrases. Human or
  5437	     7	model-assisted semantic review remains a separate gate.
  5438	     8	"""
  5439	     9

  5453	    23

  5455	    25	def parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
  5456	    26	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
  5457	    27	    parser.add_argument("--corpus", nargs="+", required=True)
  5458	    28	    parser.add_argument("--candidates", nargs="+", required=True)
  5459	    29	    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True)
  5460	    30	    parser.add_argument("--model-id", help="Force multiple candidate shards into one model group")
  5461	    31	    return parser.parse_args()

  5464	    34	def read_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  5465	    35	    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]
  5466	    36	
  5467	    37	
  5468	    38	def normalized(text: str) -> str:
  5469	    39	    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text).casefold()
  5470	    40	    value = value.replace("’", "'").replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-")
  5471	    41	    value = re.sub(r"[-_/]", " ", value)
  5472	    42	    value = re.sub(r"[^\w$%.']+", " ", value)
  5473	    43	    return " ".join(value.split())
  5474	    44	
  5475	    45	
  5476	    46	def contains_phrase(text: str, phrase: str) -> bool:
  5477	    47	    haystack = f" {normalized(text)} "
  5478	    48	    needle = normalized(phrase)
  5479	    49	    return bool(needle) and f" {needle} " in haystack
  5480	    50	
  5481	    51	
  5482	    52	def wilson(successes: int, total: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
  5483	    53	    if total == 0:
  5484	    54	        return 0.0, 0.0
  5485	    55	    z = 1.959963984540054
  5486	    56	    p = successes / total
  5487	    57	    denominator = 1 + z * z / total
  5488	    58	    center = (p + z * z / (2 * total)) / denominator
  5489	    59	    margin = z * math.sqrt((p * (1 - p) + z * z / (4 * total)) / total) / denominator
  5490	    60	    return center - margin, center + margin
  5491	    61	
  5492	    62	
  5493	    63	def structure_ok(output: str) -> tuple[bool, int, list[str]]:
  5494	    64	    lines = [line.strip() for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip()]
  5495	    65	    bullets = [line for line in lines if BULLET_RE.match(line)]
  5496	    66	    other = [line for line in lines if not BULLET_RE.match(line)]
  5497	    67	    bare_list = len(lines) == 2 and len(bullets) == 2
  5498	    68	    headed_list = (
  5499	    69	        len(lines) == 3
  5500	    70	        and not BULLET_RE.match(lines[0])
  5501	    71	        and (lines[0].endswith(":") or lines[0].endswith("—"))
  5502	    72	        and all(BULLET_RE.match(line) for line in lines[1:])
  5503	    73	    )
  5504	    74	    return bare_list or headed_list, len(bullets), other
  5505	    75

  5507	    77	def main() -> None:
  5508	    78	    args = parse_args()
  5509	    79	    cases: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
  5510	    80	    for raw_path in args.corpus:
  5511	    81	        for case in read_jsonl(Path(raw_path)):
  5512	    82	            if case["id"] in cases:
  5513	    83	                raise SystemExit(f"Duplicate corpus id: {case['id']}")
  5514	    84	            cases[case["id"]] = case
  5515	    85	
  5516	    86	    grouped_rows: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
  5517	    87	    grouped_paths: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
  5518	    88	    for raw_path in args.candidates:
  5519	    89	        path = Path(raw_path)
  5520	    90	        rows = read_jsonl(path)
  5521	    91	        if not rows:
  5522	    92	            raise SystemExit(f"Empty candidate file: {path}")
  5523	    93	        model_id = args.model_id or str(rows[0].get("model_id", path.stem))
  5524	    94	        grouped_rows[model_id].extend(rows)
  5525	    95	        grouped_paths[model_id].append(str(path))
  5526	    96	
  5527	    97	    results: dict[str, Any] = {"case_count": len(cases), "models": {}}
  5528	    98	    for model_id, rows in grouped_rows.items():
  5529	    99	        path_label = ", ".join(grouped_paths[model_id])
  5530	   100	        by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in rows}
  5531	   101	        if len(by_id) != len(rows):
  5532	   102	            raise SystemExit(f"{model_id}: duplicate candidate ids across {path_label}")
  5533	   103	        missing = sorted(set(cases) - set(by_id))
  5534	   104	        extra = sorted(set(by_id) - set(cases))
  5535	   105	        if missing or extra:
  5536	   106	            raise SystemExit(f"{model_id}: missing={missing}, extra={extra}")
  5537	   107	
  5538	   108	        details: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  5539	   109	        breakdown: dict[str, Counter[str]] = defaultdict(Counter)
  5540	   110	        for case_id, case in cases.items():
  5541	   111	            row = by_id[case_id]
  5542	   112	            output = str(row.get("output", row.get("candidate", ""))).strip()
  5543	   113	            absent_required = [p for p in case["required"] if not contains_phrase(output, p)]
  5544	   114	            present_forbidden = [p for p in case["forbidden"] if contains_phrase(output, p)]
  5545	   115	            valid_structure, bullet_count, extra_lines = structure_ok(output)
  5546	   116	            strict = not absent_required and not present_forbidden and valid_structure
  5547	   117	            details.append(
  5548	   118	                {
  5549	   119	                    "id": case_id,
  5550	   120	                    "domain": case["domain"],
  5551	   121	                    "list_type": case["list_type"],
  5552	   122	                    "structure_ok": valid_structure,
  5553	   123	                    "bullet_count": bullet_count,
  5554	   124	                    "extra_lines": extra_lines,
  5555	   125	                    "absent_required": absent_required,
  5556	   126	                    "present_forbidden": present_forbidden,
  5557	   127	                    "strict": strict,
  5558	   128	                    "output": output,
  5559	   129	                }
  5560	   130	            )
  5561	   131	            for key in (f"domain:{case['domain']}", f"list_type:{case['list_type']}"):
  5562	   132	                breakdown[key]["total"] += 1
  5563	   133	                breakdown[key]["strict"] += int(strict)
  5564	   134	
  5565	   135	        strict_count = sum(item["strict"] for item in details)
  5566	   136	        low, high = wilson(strict_count, len(details))
  5567	   137	        results["models"][model_id] = {
  5568	   138	            "candidate_paths": grouped_paths[model_id],
  5569	   139	            "strict": strict_count,
  5570	   140	            "total": len(details),
  5571	   141	            "strict_rate": strict_count / len(details),
  5572	   142	            "wilson_95": [low, high],
  5573	   143	            "structure_ok": sum(item["structure_ok"] for item in details),
  5574	   144	            "required_ok": sum(not item["absent_required"] for item in details),
  5575	   145	            "forbidden_ok": sum(not item["present_forbidden"] for item in details),
  5576	   146	            "breakdown": {key: dict(value) for key, value in sorted(breakdown.items())},
  5577	   147	            "failures": [item for item in details if not item["strict"]],
  5578	   148	        }
  5579	   149	
  5580	   150	    output_path = Path(args.out)
  5581	   151	    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  5582	   152	    output_path.write_text(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
  5583	   153	    print(json.dumps({key: {"strict": value["strict"], "total": value["total"]} for key, value in results["models"].items()}, indent=2))
  5584	   154	
  5585	   155	
  5586	   156	if __name__ == "__main__":
  5587	   157	    main()

  5615	    28	def rows(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  5616	    29	    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]
  5617	    30

  5619	    32	def output_text(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
  5620	    33	    return str(row.get("output", row.get("candidate", ""))).strip()
  5621	    34

  5623	    36	def list_lines(text: str) -> int:
  5624	    37	    return sum(bool(LIST_LINE_RE.match(line)) for line in text.splitlines())

  5627	    40	def wilson(successes: int, total: int) -> list[float]:
  5628	    41	    if total == 0:
  5629	    42	        return [0.0, 0.0]
  5630	    43	    z = 1.959963984540054
  5631	    44	    p = successes / total
  5632	    45	    denominator = 1 + z * z / total
  5633	    46	    center = (p + z * z / (2 * total)) / denominator
  5634	    47	    margin = z * math.sqrt((p * (1 - p) + z * z / (4 * total)) / total) / denominator
  5635	    48	    return [center - margin, center + margin]
  5636	    49	
  5637	    50	
  5638	    51	def group(paths: list[Path]) -> dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
  5639	    52	    grouped: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(dict)
  5640	    53	    for path in paths:
  5641	    54	        part = rows(path)
  5642	    55	        if not part:
  5643	    56	            raise ValueError(f"empty candidate file: {path}")
  5644	    57	        model_id = str(part[0].get("model_id", path.stem))
  5645	    58	        for row in part:
  5646	    59	            row_id = str(row["id"])
  5647	    60	            if row_id in grouped[model_id]:
  5648	    61	                raise ValueError(f"duplicate candidate id {row_id!r} for {model_id}")
  5649	    62	            grouped[model_id][row_id] = row
  5650	    63	    return grouped
  5651	    64	
  5652	    65	
  5653	    66	def main() -> None:
  5654	    67	    args = parse_args()
  5655	    68	    positive = {str(row["id"]): row for row in rows(args.positive_corpus)}
  5656	    69	    traps = {str(row["id"]): row for row in rows(args.trap_corpus)}
  5657	    70	    positive_groups = group(args.positive_candidates)
  5658	    71	    trap_groups = group(args.trap_candidates)
  5659	    72	    if set(positive_groups) != set(trap_groups):
  5660	    73	        raise ValueError("positive and trap candidate model sets differ")
  5661	    74	
  5662	    75	    report: dict[str, Any] = {
  5663	    76	        "positive_corpus": str(args.positive_corpus),
  5664	    77	        "trap_corpus": str(args.trap_corpus),
  5665	    78	        "models": {},
  5666	    79	    }
  5667	    80	    for model_id in sorted(positive_groups):
  5668	    81	        positive_rows = positive_groups[model_id]
  5669	    82	        trap_rows = trap_groups[model_id]
  5670	    83	        if set(positive_rows) != set(positive):
  5671	    84	            raise ValueError(f"{model_id}: positive IDs do not match corpus")
  5672	    85	        if set(trap_rows) != set(traps):
  5673	    86	            raise ValueError(f"{model_id}: trap IDs do not match corpus")
  5674	    87	
  5675	    88	        positive_details = []
  5676	    89	        for row_id, case in positive.items():
  5677	    90	            count = list_lines(output_text(positive_rows[row_id]))
  5678	    91	            intended = int(case["item_count"])
  5679	    92	            positive_details.append(
  5680	    93	                {
  5681	    94	                    "id": row_id,
  5682	    95	                    "list_lines": count,
  5683	    96	                    "intended_items": intended,
  5684	    97	                    "activated": count >= 2,
  5685	    98	                    "intended_count": count == intended,
  5686	    99	                }
  5687	   100	            )
  5688	   101	        trap_details = []
  5689	   102	        for row_id in traps:
  5690	   103	            count = list_lines(output_text(trap_rows[row_id]))
  5691	   104	            trap_details.append({"id": row_id, "list_lines": count, "false_list": count >= 2})
  5692	   105	
  5693	   106	        activated = sum(item["activated"] for item in positive_details)
  5694	   107	        intended_count = sum(item["intended_count"] for item in positive_details)
  5695	   108	        false_lists = sum(item["false_list"] for item in trap_details)
  5696	   109	        report["models"][model_id] = {
  5697	   110	            "positive_total": len(positive_details),
  5698	   111	            "activated": activated,
  5699	   112	            "activated_wilson_95": wilson(activated, len(positive_details)),
  5700	   113	            "intended_count": intended_count,
  5701	   114	            "intended_count_wilson_95": wilson(intended_count, len(positive_details)),
  5702	   115	            "trap_total": len(trap_details),
  5703	   116	            "false_lists": false_lists,
  5704	   117	            "restraint": len(trap_details) - false_lists,
  5705	   118	            "restraint_wilson_95": wilson(len(trap_details) - false_lists, len(trap_details)),
  5706	   119	            "positive_mismatches": [item for item in positive_details if not item["intended_count"]],
  5707	   120	            "false_list_cases": [item for item in trap_details if item["false_list"]],
  5708	   121	        }
  5709	   122	
  5710	   123	    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  5711	   124	    args.out.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
  5712	   125	    print(
  5713	   126	        json.dumps(
  5714	   127	            {
  5715	   128	                model: {
  5716	   129	                    "activated": score["activated"],
  5717	   130	                    "intended_count": score["intended_count"],
  5718	   131	                    "false_lists": score["false_lists"],
  5719	   132	                }
  5720	   133	                for model, score in report["models"].items()
  5721	   134	            },
  5722	   135	            indent=2,
  5723	   136	        )
  5724	   137	    )
  5725	   138	
  5726	   139	
  5727	   140	if __name__ == "__main__":
  5728	   141	    main()

  5757	    29	    path: Path, value: bytes, before_link: Callable[[], None] | None = None
  5758	    30	) -> None:
  5759	    31	    fd, temp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=f".{path.name}.", dir=path.parent)

  5761	    33	    try:
  5762	    34	        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as handle:
  5763	    35	            handle.write(value)
  5764	    36	            handle.flush()
  5765	    37	            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
  5766	    38	        if before_link is not None:
  5767	    39	            before_link()
  5768	    40	        os.link(temp, path)
  5769	    41	    finally:
  5770	    42	        temp.unlink(missing_ok=True)

  5782	    54	def read_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  5783	    55	    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  5784	    56	    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as handle:

  5786	    58	            if not line.strip():

  5791	    63	            rows.append(row)
  5792	    64	    if not rows:
  5793	    65	        raise ValueError(f"empty JSONL: {path}")
  5794	    66	    return rows

  5797	    69	def file_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
  5798	    70	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
  5799	    71	    with path.open("rb") as handle:
  5800	    72	        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
  5801	    73	            digest.update(chunk)
  5802	    74	    return digest.hexdigest()

  5814	    86	def normalized(text: str) -> str:
  5815	    87	    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text).casefold()
  5816	    88	    value = value.replace("’", "'").replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-")
  5817	    89	    value = re.sub(r"[-_/]", " ", value)
  5818	    90	    value = re.sub(r"[^\w$%]+", " ", value, flags=re.UNICODE)
  5819	    91	    return " ".join(value.split())

  5822	    94	def contains_phrase(text: str, phrase: str) -> bool:
  5823	    95	    haystack = f" {normalized(text)} "
  5824	    96	    needle = normalized(phrase)
  5825	    97	    return bool(needle) and f" {needle} " in haystack

  5828	   100	def wilson(successes: int, total: int) -> list[float] | None:
  5829	   101	    if total == 0:
  5830	   102	        return None
  5831	   103	    z = 1.959963984540054
  5832	   104	    rate = successes / total
  5833	   105	    denominator = 1 + z * z / total
  5834	   106	    center = (rate + z * z / (2 * total)) / denominator
  5835	   107	    margin = z * math.sqrt((rate * (1 - rate) + z * z / (4 * total)) / total) / denominator
  5836	   108	    return [center - margin, center + margin]

  5840	   112	    return {
  5841	   113	        "successes": successes,
  5842	   114	        "total": total,
  5843	   115	        "rate": successes / total if total else None,
  5844	   116	        "wilson_95": wilson(successes, total),

  5848	   120	def load_corpus(path: Path, role: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
  5849	   121	    cases: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
  5850	   122	    for line_number, case in enumerate(read_jsonl(path), 1):
  5851	   123	        case_id = case.get("id")
  5852	   124	        if not isinstance(case_id, str) or not case_id:
  5853	   125	            raise ValueError(f"{path}:{line_number}: missing id")
  5854	   126	        if case_id in cases:
  5855	   127	            raise ValueError(f"{path}:{line_number}: duplicate corpus id {case_id!r}")
  5856	   128	        if (
  5857	   129	            case.get("split") != "dev"
  5858	   130	            or case.get("gold_status") != "candidate_unreviewed"
  5859	   131	            or case.get("native_reviewed") is not False
  5860	   132	            or case.get("training_eligible") is not False
  5861	   133	        ):
  5862	   134	            raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: corpus is not development/unreviewed/non-training data")
  5863	   135	        if case.get("benchmark_role") != role:
  5864	   136	            raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: expected benchmark_role {role!r}")
  5865	   137	        for field in ("domain", "case_type", "length_bucket"):
  5866	   138	            if not isinstance(case.get(field), str) or not case[field]:
  5867	   139	                raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: invalid {field}")
  5868	   140	        if not isinstance(case.get("item_count"), int) or case["item_count"] < 1:
  5869	   141	            raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: invalid item_count")
  5870	   142	        if not isinstance(case.get("compound_required"), bool):
  5871	   143	            raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: invalid compound_required")
  5872	   144	        for field in ("items", "compound_items", "scope_anchors", "forbidden"):
  5873	   145	            if not isinstance(case.get(field), list) or not all(
  5874	   146	                isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() for value in case[field]
  5875	   147	            ):
  5876	   148	                raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: invalid {field}")
  5877	   149	        if len(case["items"]) != case["item_count"] or not case["scope_anchors"]:
  5878	   150	            raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: audited item/scope coverage is invalid")
  5879	   151	        normalized_items = {normalized(value) for value in case["items"]}
  5880	   152	        normalized_compounds = {normalized(value) for value in case["compound_items"]}
  5881	   153	        if (
  5882	   154	            len(normalized_items) != case["item_count"]
  5883	   155	            or not normalized_compounds.issubset(normalized_items)
  5884	   156	            or case["compound_required"] != bool(case["compound_items"])
  5885	   157	        ):
  5886	   158	            raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: audited compound/item contract is invalid")
  5887	   159	        expected_format = case.get("expected_formatting")
  5888	   160	        allowed = {"bullets", "numbered"} if role == "positive_list" else {"prose"}
  5889	   161	        if expected_format not in allowed:
  5890	   162	            raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: invalid expected_formatting {expected_format!r}")
  5891	   163	        cases[case_id] = case
  5892	   164	    return cases

  5895	   167	def candidate_text(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
  5896	   168	    value = row.get("output", row.get("candidate"))
  5897	   169	    return value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) else ""
  5898	   170	
  5899	   171	
  5900	   172	def candidate_error(row: dict[str, Any]) -> Any | None:
  5901	   173	    value = row.get("error")
  5902	   174	    return None if value is None or value == "" else value
  5903	   175	
  5904	   176	
  5905	   177	def score_candidate(
  5906	   178	    case: dict[str, Any],
  5907	   179	    row: dict[str, Any],
  5908	   180	    scorer: Callable[[dict[str, Any], str], dict[str, Any]],
  5909	   181	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  5910	   182	    output = candidate_text(row)
  5911	   183	    result = scorer(case, output)
  5912	   184	    error = candidate_error(row)
  5913	   185	    inference_ok = error is None and bool(output)
  5914	   186	    result["candidate_error"] = error
  5915	   187	    result["empty_output"] = not bool(output)
  5916	   188	    result["inference_ok"] = inference_ok
  5917	   189	    if not inference_ok:
  5918	   190	        result["strict"] = False
  5919	   191	    return result

  5922	   194	def load_candidates(paths: list[Path]) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]], dict[str, list[str]]]:
  5923	   195	    grouped: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(dict)
  5924	   196	    sources: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
  5925	   197	    for path in paths:
  5926	   198	        rows = read_jsonl(path)
  5927	   199	        models_in_file: set[str] = set()
  5928	   200	        for line_number, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
  5929	   201	            model_id = row.get("model_id", path.stem)
  5930	   202	            case_id = row.get("id")
  5931	   203	            if not isinstance(model_id, str) or not model_id:

  6143	     2	"""Deterministically score audited two-item list development cases.
  6144	     3	
  6145	     4	This scorer is intentionally narrow. It checks only facts that the corpus can

  6148	     7	model-assisted semantic review remains a separate gate.

  6175	    34	def read_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  6176	    35	    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line]

  6179	    38	def normalized(text: str) -> str:
  6180	    39	    value = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text).casefold()
  6181	    40	    value = value.replace("’", "'").replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-")
  6182	    41	    value = re.sub(r"[-_/]", " ", value)
  6183	    42	    value = re.sub(r"[^\w$%.']+", " ", value)
  6184	    43	    return " ".join(value.split())
  6185	    44	
  6186	    45	
  6187	    46	def contains_phrase(text: str, phrase: str) -> bool:
  6188	    47	    haystack = f" {normalized(text)} "
  6189	    48	    needle = normalized(phrase)
  6190	    49	    return bool(needle) and f" {needle} " in haystack
  6191	    50	
  6192	    51	
  6193	    52	def wilson(successes: int, total: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
  6194	    53	    if total == 0:
  6195	    54	        return 0.0, 0.0
  6196	    55	    z = 1.959963984540054
  6197	    56	    p = successes / total
  6198	    57	    denominator = 1 + z * z / total
  6199	    58	    center = (p + z * z / (2 * total)) / denominator
  6200	    59	    margin = z * math.sqrt((p * (1 - p) + z * z / (4 * total)) / total) / denominator
  6201	    60	    return center - margin, center + margin
  6202	    61	
  6203	    62	
  6204	    63	def structure_ok(output: str) -> tuple[bool, int, list[str]]:
  6205	    64	    lines = [line.strip() for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip()]
  6206	    65	    bullets = [line for line in lines if BULLET_RE.match(line)]
  6207	    66	    other = [line for line in lines if not BULLET_RE.match(line)]
  6208	    67	    bare_list = len(lines) == 2 and len(bullets) == 2
  6209	    68	    headed_list = (
  6210	    69	        len(lines) == 3
  6211	    70	        and not BULLET_RE.match(lines[0])
  6212	    71	        and (lines[0].endswith(":") or lines[0].endswith("—"))
  6213	    72	        and all(BULLET_RE.match(line) for line in lines[1:])
  6214	    73	    )
  6215	    74	    return bare_list or headed_list, len(bullets), other

  6218	    77	def main() -> None:
  6219	    78	    args = parse_args()

  6221	    80	    for raw_path in args.corpus:
  6222	    81	        for case in read_jsonl(Path(raw_path)):
  6223	    82	            if case["id"] in cases:
  6224	    83	                raise SystemExit(f"Duplicate corpus id: {case['id']}")
  6225	    84	            cases[case["id"]] = case
  6226	    85	
  6227	    86	    grouped_rows: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
  6228	    87	    grouped_paths: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
  6229	    88	    for raw_path in args.candidates:
  6230	    89	        path = Path(raw_path)
  6231	    90	        rows = read_jsonl(path)
  6232	    91	        if not rows:
  6233	    92	            raise SystemExit(f"Empty candidate file: {path}")
  6234	    93	        model_id = args.model_id or str(rows[0].get("model_id", path.stem))
  6235	    94	        grouped_rows[model_id].extend(rows)
  6236	    95	        grouped_paths[model_id].append(str(path))
  6237	    96	
  6238	    97	    results: dict[str, Any] = {"case_count": len(cases), "models": {}}
  6239	    98	    for model_id, rows in grouped_rows.items():
  6240	    99	        path_label = ", ".join(grouped_paths[model_id])
  6241	   100	        by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in rows}
  6242	   101	        if len(by_id) != len(rows):
  6243	   102	            raise SystemExit(f"{model_id}: duplicate candidate ids across {path_label}")
  6244	   103	        missing = sorted(set(cases) - set(by_id))
  6245	   104	        extra = sorted(set(by_id) - set(cases))
  6246	   105	        if missing or extra:
  6247	   106	            raise SystemExit(f"{model_id}: missing={missing}, extra={extra}")
  6248	   107	
  6249	   108	        details: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  6250	   109	        breakdown: dict[str, Counter[str]] = defaultdict(Counter)
  6251	   110	        for case_id, case in cases.items():
  6252	   111	            row = by_id[case_id]
  6253	   112	            output = str(row.get("output", row.get("candidate", ""))).strip()
  6254	   113	            absent_required = [p for p in case["required"] if not contains_phrase(output, p)]
  6255	   114	            present_forbidden = [p for p in case["forbidden"] if contains_phrase(output, p)]
  6256	   115	            valid_structure, bullet_count, extra_lines = structure_ok(output)
  6257	   116	            strict = not absent_required and not present_forbidden and valid_structure
  6258	   117	            details.append(
  6259	   118	                {
  6260	   119	                    "id": case_id,
  6261	   120	                    "domain": case["domain"],
  6262	   121	                    "list_type": case["list_type"],
  6263	   122	                    "structure_ok": valid_structure,
  6264	   123	                    "bullet_count": bullet_count,
  6265	   124	                    "extra_lines": extra_lines,
  6266	   125	                    "absent_required": absent_required,
  6267	   126	                    "present_forbidden": present_forbidden,
  6268	   127	                    "strict": strict,
  6269	   128	                    "output": output,
  6270	   129	                }
  6271	   130	            )
  6272	   131	            for key in (f"domain:{case['domain']}", f"list_type:{case['list_type']}"):
  6273	   132	                breakdown[key]["total"] += 1
  6274	   133	                breakdown[key]["strict"] += int(strict)
  6275	   134	
  6276	   135	        strict_count = sum(item["strict"] for item in details)
  6277	   136	        low, high = wilson(strict_count, len(details))
  6278	   137	        results["models"][model_id] = {
  6279	   138	            "candidate_paths": grouped_paths[model_id],
  6280	   139	            "strict": strict_count,
  6281	   140	            "total": len(details),
  6282	   141	            "strict_rate": strict_count / len(details),
  6283	   142	            "wilson_95": [low, high],
  6284	   143	            "structure_ok": sum(item["structure_ok"] for item in details),
  6285	   144	            "required_ok": sum(not item["absent_required"] for item in details),
  6286	   145	            "forbidden_ok": sum(not item["present_forbidden"] for item in details),
  6287	   146	            "breakdown": {key: dict(value) for key, value in sorted(breakdown.items())},
  6288	   147	            "failures": [item for item in details if not item["strict"]],
  6289	   148	        }
  6290	   149	
  6291	   150	    output_path = Path(args.out)
  6292	   151	    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  6293	   152	    output_path.write_text(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
  6294	   153	    print(json.dumps({key: {"strict": value["strict"], "total": value["total"]} for key, value in results["models"].items()}, indent=2))

  6450	   152	    rows = parse_jsonl(value, label)
  6451	   153	    if len(rows) != EXPECTED_LANE_CASES:
  6452	   154	        raise ValueError(f"{label} must contain exactly {EXPECTED_LANE_CASES} cases")
  6453	   155	    for row in rows:
  6454	   156	        case_id = row.get("id")
  6455	   157	        transcript = row.get("input")
  6456	   158	        if not isinstance(case_id, str) or not case_id or case_id in seen:
  6457	   159	            raise ValueError("corpus has an invalid or duplicate case ID")
  6458	   160	        if not isinstance(transcript, str) or not transcript.strip():
  6459	   161	            raise ValueError(f"{case_id}: corpus has an invalid input")
  6460	   162	        seen.add(case_id)
  6461	   163	    return rows

  6464	   166	def outputs_by_id(value: bytes, expected_ids: list[str], arm: str) -> dict[str, str]:
  6465	   167	    rows = parse_jsonl(value, f"{arm} output")
  6466	   168	    ids = [row.get("id") for row in rows]
  6467	   169	    if ids != expected_ids or len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
  6468	   170	        raise ValueError(f"{arm} output IDs/order differ from the corpora")
  6469	   171	    outputs: dict[str, str] = {}
  6470	   172	    for row in rows:
  6471	   173	        value = row.get("candidate")
  6472	   174	        if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip() or row.get("error") not in (None, ""):
  6473	   175	            raise ValueError(f"{arm}:{row.get('id')} is not reviewable")
  6474	   176	        outputs[row["id"]] = value
  6475	   177	    return outputs

  6756	    39	    "medium": (23, 38),
  6757	    40	    "long": (39, 58),
  6758	    41	    "extended": (59, 85),

  6810	   182	def load_json_rows(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  6811	   183	    return load_json_rows_bytes(path, path.read_bytes())
  6812	   184	
  6813	   185	
  6814	   186	def load_audit_sources(paths: list[str]) -> tuple[list[AuditInput], list[dict[str, Any]], set[str]]:
  6815	   187	    audit_inputs: list[AuditInput] = []
  6816	   188	    inventories: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  6817	   189	    families: set[str] = set()
  6818	   190	    for raw_path in paths:
  6819	   191	        path = Path(raw_path).resolve()
  6820	   192	        if not path.is_file():
  6821	   193	            raise ValueError(f"audit source does not exist: {path}")
  6822	   194	        source_bytes = path.read_bytes()
  6823	   195	        rows = load_json_rows_bytes(path, source_bytes)
  6824	   196	        source_sha = sha256_bytes(source_bytes)
  6825	   197	        input_count = 0
  6826	   198	        for index, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
  6827	   199	            family = row.get("family")
  6828	   200	            if isinstance(family, str) and family.strip():
  6829	   201	                families.add(normalized(family))
  6830	   202	            value = input_value(row)
  6831	   203	            if value is None:
  6832	   204	                continue
  6833	   205	            key = normalized(value)
  6834	   206	            if not key:
  6835	   207	                continue
  6836	   208	            input_count += 1
  6837	   209	            audit_inputs.append(
  6838	   210	                AuditInput(
  6839	   211	                    source=str(path),
  6840	   212	                    source_id=str(row.get("id", index)),
  6841	   213	                    normalized=key,
  6842	   214	                    tokens=frozenset(key.split()),
  6843	   215	                    char_4grams=char_ngrams(key),
  6844	   216	                )
  6845	   217	            )
  6846	   218	        inventories.append(
  6847	   219	            {
  6848	   220	                "path": str(path),
  6849	   221	                "sha256": source_sha,
  6850	   222	                "row_count": len(rows),
  6851	   223	                "input_count": input_count,
  6852	   224	            }
  6853	   225	        )
  6854	   226	    if not audit_inputs:
  6855	   227	        raise ValueError("audit sources contain no input/asr_input/raw/transcript values")
  6856	   228	    return audit_inputs, inventories, families
  6857	   229	
  6858	   230	
  6859	   231	def pairwise_balance(specs: list[CaseSpec]) -> dict[str, dict[str, int]]:
  6860	   232	    axes = ("domain", "case_type", "item_count", "length_bucket", "compound_required")
  6861	   233	    axis_values = {
  6862	   234	        axis: sorted({getattr(spec, axis) for spec in specs}, key=str)
  6863	   235	        for axis in axes
  6864	   236	    }
  6865	   237	    result: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
  6866	   238	    for left_index, left in enumerate(axes):
  6867	   239	        for right in axes[left_index + 1 :]:
  6868	   240	            counts: Counter[str] = Counter(
  6869	   241	                f"{getattr(spec, left)}|{getattr(spec, right)}" for spec in specs
  6870	   242	            )
  6871	   243	            result[f"{left}_x_{right}"] = {
  6872	   244	                f"{left_value}|{right_value}": counts[f"{left_value}|{right_value}"]
  6873	   245	                for left_value, right_value in product(axis_values[left], axis_values[right])
  6874	   246	            }
  6875	   247	    return result
  6876	   248	
  6877	   249	
  6878	   250	def balanced_specs(role: str, count: int, seed: int) -> list[CaseSpec]:
  6879	   251	    if count <= 0 or count % 20:
  6880	   252	        raise ValueError("--count-per-role must be a positive multiple of 20")
  6881	   253	    case_types = POSITIVE_TYPES if role == "positive_list" else RESTRAINT_TYPES
  6882	   254	    repeats = count // (len(DOMAINS) * len(case_types))
  6883	   255	    slots = [
  6884	   256	        (domain, case_type, repeat, bool((domain_index + type_index + repeat) % 2))
  6885	   257	        for domain_index, domain in enumerate(DOMAINS)
  6886	   258	        for type_index, case_type in enumerate(case_types)
  6887	   259	        for repeat in range(repeats)
  6888	   260	    ]
  6889	   261	    item_counts = list(ITEM_COUNTS)
  6890	   262	    length_buckets = list(LENGTH_BUCKETS)
  6891	   263	    rng = random.Random(seed)
  6892	   264	    candidate = [
  6893	   265	        CaseSpec(
  6894	   266	            spec_id="pending",
  6895	   267	            role=role,
  6896	   268	            domain=domain,
  6897	   269	            case_type=case_type,
  6898	   270	            item_count=item_counts[(repeat + 2 * domain_index + type_index) % 4],
  6899	   271	            length_bucket=length_buckets[(2 * repeat + domain_index + type_index) % 4],
  6900	   272	            compound_required=compound_required,
  6901	   273	        )
  6902	   274	        for domain_index, domain in enumerate(DOMAINS)
  6903	   275	        for type_index, case_type in enumerate(case_types)
  6904	   276	        for repeat, (_, _, _, compound_required) in enumerate(
  6905	   277	            slot for slot in slots if slot[0] == domain and slot[1] == case_type
  6906	   278	        )
  6907	   279	    ]
  6908	   280	    rng.shuffle(candidate)
  6909	   281	    return [
  6910	   282	        CaseSpec(spec_id=f"{role}-{index + 1:03d}", **{key: value for key, value in asdict(spec).items() if key != "spec_id"})
  6911	   283	        for index, spec in enumerate(candidate)
  6912	   284	    ]
  6913	   285

  6915	   287	def subscription_env() -> dict[str, str]:
  6916	   288	    return {
  6917	   289	        key: value
  6918	   290	        for key, value in os.environ.items()
  6919	   291	        if not key.startswith("ANTHROPIC_")
  6920	   292	        and key not in ("CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK", "CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX")
  6921	   293	    }

  6924	   296	def call_claude(model: str, system: str, user: str, timeout_seconds: int) -> str:
  6925	   297	    try:
  6926	   298	        process = subprocess.run(
  6927	   299	            [
  6928	   300	                "claude",
  6929	   700	        system, user = generation_prompt(batch)
  6930	   701	        prompt_sha = sha256_bytes((system + "\n" + user).encode())
  6931	   702	        prompt_record = {
  6932	   703	            "role": role,
  6933	   704	            "batch": batch_index,
  6934	   705	            "spec_ids": [spec.spec_id for spec in batch],
  6935	   706	            "prompt_sha256": prompt_sha,
  6936	   707	            "reused_checkpoint": False,
  6937	   708	        }
  6938	   709	        prompt_records.append(prompt_record)
  6939	   710	        accepted: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]] | None = None
  6940	   711	        last_error: Exception | None = None
  6941	   712	        checkpoint = checkpoint_dir / f"{role}-batch-{batch_index:03d}.json" if checkpoint_dir else None
  6942	   713	        if checkpoint and checkpoint.is_file():
  6943	   714	            cached = json.loads(checkpoint.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
  6944	   715	            if (
  6945	   716	                cached.get("prompt_sha256") != prompt_sha
  6946	   717	                or cached.get("specs") != [asdict(spec) for spec in batch]
  6947	   718	                or not isinstance(cached.get("rows"), list)
  6948	   719	            ):
  6949	   720	                raise RuntimeError(f"checkpoint does not match current prompt/specs: {checkpoint}")
  6950	   721	            accepted = validate_batch(cached["rows"], batch, blocked, families)
  6951	   722	            prompt_record["reused_checkpoint"] = True
  6952	   723	        else:
  6953	   724	            for attempt in range(1, args.attempts_per_batch + 1):
  6954	   725	                try:
  6955	   726	                    raw_rows = clean_json(
  6956	   727	                        call_claude(args.model, system, user, args.call_timeout_seconds)
  6957	   728	                    )
  6958	   729	                    accepted = validate_batch(raw_rows, batch, blocked, families)
  6959	   730	                    if checkpoint:
  6960	   731	                        publish_bytes_exclusive(
  6961	   732	                            checkpoint,
  6962	   733	                            (
  6963	   734	                                json.dumps(
  6964	   735	                                    {
  6965	   736	                                        "prompt_sha256": prompt_sha,
  6966	   737	                                        "specs": [asdict(spec) for spec in batch],
  6967	   738	                                        "rows": raw_rows,
  6968	   739	                                    },
  6969	   740	                                    ensure_ascii=False,
  6970	   741	                                    indent=2,
  6971	   742	                                    sort_keys=True,
  6972	   743	                                )
  6973	   744	                                + "\n"
  6974	   745	                            ).encode("utf-8"),
  6975	   746	                        )
  6976	   747	                    break
  6977	   748	                except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError, RuntimeError) as error:
  6978	   749	                    last_error = error
  6979	   750	                    failures.append({
  6980	   751	                        "role": role,
  6981	   752	                        "batch": str(batch_index),
  6982	   753	                        "attempt": str(attempt),
  6983	   754	                        "reason": str(error)[:500],
  6984	   755	                    })
  6985	   756	                    print(f"{role} batch {batch_index} attempt {attempt} failed: {error}", flush=True)
  6986	   757	        if accepted is None:
  6987	   758	            raise RuntimeError(f"{role} batch {batch_index} failed after {args.attempts_per_batch} attempts: {last_error}")
  6988	   759	        for spec, (row, similarity_audit) in zip(batch, accepted):
  6989	   760	            enriched = enrich(row, spec, args.batch_id, similarity_audit)
  6990	   761	            rows.append(enriched)
  6991	   762	            families.add(normalized(row["family"]))
  6992	   763	            blocked.append(as_audit_input("generated", enriched["id"], row["input"]))
  6993	   764	        print(f"accepted {role} batch {batch_index}: {len(accepted)} rows", flush=True)
  6994	   765	    return rows, prompt_records, failures, blocked, families

  6997	   768	def ensure_source_snapshots_unchanged(inventories: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
  6998	   769	    for inventory in inventories:

  7001	   772	            raise RuntimeError(f"audit source changed during generation: {path}")

  7005	   776	    if args.manifest_output:

  7007	   778	    positive = Path(args.positive_output).resolve()
  7008	   779	    return positive.with_name(f"{positive.stem}.benchmark-manifest.json")

  7011	   782	def main() -> None:
  7012	   783	    args = parse_args()
  7013	   784	    if args.batch_size <= 0 or args.count_per_role % args.batch_size:
  7014	   785	        raise SystemExit("--batch-size must be positive and divide --count-per-role")
  7015	   786	    if args.call_timeout_seconds <= 0:
  7016	   787	        raise SystemExit("--call-timeout-seconds must be positive")
  7017	   788	    source_paths = [*args.audit_corpus, *args.prior_batch]
  7018	   789	    if not source_paths:
  7019	   790	        raise SystemExit("supply at least one --audit-corpus or --prior-batch")
  7020	   791	    if len({str(Path(path).resolve()) for path in source_paths}) != len(source_paths):
  7021	   792	        raise SystemExit("duplicate audit/prior source path")
  7022	   793	
  7023	   794	    audit_inputs, inventories, audit_families = load_audit_sources(source_paths)
  7024	   795	    positive_path = Path(args.positive_output).resolve()
  7025	   796	    restraint_path = Path(args.restraint_output).resolve()
  7026	   797	    started = time.time()
  7027	   798	    prompt_records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  7028	   799	    failures: list[dict[str, str]] = []
  7029	   800	
  7030	   801	    if args.mode == "generate":
  7031	   802	        positive_specs = balanced_specs("positive_list", args.count_per_role, args.seed)
  7032	   803	        restraint_specs = balanced_specs("prose_restraint", args.count_per_role, args.seed + 1)
  7033	   804	        positive_rows, records, failed, generated_inputs, generated_families = generate_role(
  7034	   805	            "positive_list", positive_specs, args, audit_inputs, audit_families
  7035	   806	        )
  7036	   807	        prompt_records.extend(records)
  7037	   808	        failures.extend(failed)
  7038	   809	        restraint_rows, records, failed, _, _ = generate_role(
  7039	   810	            "prose_restraint", restraint_specs, args, generated_inputs, generated_families
  7040	   811	        )
  7041	   812	        prompt_records.extend(records)
  7042	   813	        failures.extend(failed)
  7043	   814	        ensure_source_snapshots_unchanged(inventories)
  7044	   815	        write_jsonl(positive_path, positive_rows)
  7045	   816	        write_jsonl(restraint_path, restraint_rows)
  7046	   817	    elif not positive_path.is_file() or not restraint_path.is_file():
  7047	   818	        raise SystemExit("--mode validate requires existing positive and restraint outputs")
  7048	   819	
  7049	   820	    positive_rows, positive_report = validate_complete_corpus(
  7050	   821	        positive_path, "positive_list", args.count_per_role, audit_inputs, audit_families
  7051	   822	    )
  7052	   823	    positive_as_audit = [
  7053	   824	        as_audit_input(str(positive_path), row["id"], row["input"]) for row in positive_rows
  7054	   825	    ]
  7055	   826	    positive_families = audit_families | {normalized(row["family"]) for row in positive_rows}
  7056	   827	    _, restraint_report = validate_complete_corpus(
  7057	   828	        restraint_path,
  7058	   829	        "prose_restraint",
  7059	   830	        args.count_per_role,
  7060	   831	        [*audit_inputs, *positive_as_audit],
  7061	   832	        positive_families,
  7062	   833	    )
  7063	   834	    ensure_source_snapshots_unchanged(inventories)
  7064	   835	
  7065	   836	    generator_path = Path(__file__).resolve()
  7066	   837	    generator_sha = file_sha256(generator_path)
  7067	   838	    manifest = {
  7068	   839	        "status": "candidate_requires_independent_native_review",
  7069	   840	        "model_blind": True,
  7070	   841	        "frozen": False,
  7071	   842	        "training_eligible": False,
  7072	   843	        "native_reviewed": False,
  7073	   844	        "created_at_epoch": started,
  7074	   845	        "elapsed_seconds": round(time.time() - started, 3),
  7075	   846	        "mode": args.mode,
  7076	   847	        "generator": str(generator_path),
  7077	   848	        "generator_sha256": generator_sha,
  7078	   849	        "model": args.model if args.mode == "generate" else None,
  7079	   850	        "batch_id": args.batch_id,
  7080	   851	        "seed": args.seed,
  7081	   852	        "count_per_role": args.count_per_role,
  7082	   853	        "batch_size": args.batch_size,
  7083	   854	        "call_timeout_seconds": args.call_timeout_seconds,
  7084	   855	        "similarity_thresholds": SIMILARITY_THRESHOLDS,
  7085	   856	        "audit_sources": inventories,
  7086	   857	        "audit_source_roles": {
  7087	   858	            "training_and_eval": [str(Path(path).resolve()) for path in args.audit_corpus],
  7088	   859	            "prior_generated_batches": [str(Path(path).resolve()) for path in args.prior_batch],
  7089	   860	        },
  7090	   861	        "prompt_batches": prompt_records,
  7091	   862	        "rejected_attempts": failures,
  7092	   863	        "outputs": {
  7093	   864	            "positive_list": positive_report,
  7094	   865	            "prose_restraint": restraint_report,
  7095	   866	        },
  7096	   867	    }
  7097	   868	    output_manifest = manifest_path(args)
  7098	   869	
  7099	   870	    def verify_before_manifest_link() -> None:
  7100	   871	        ensure_source_snapshots_unchanged(inventories)
  7101	   872	        for report, label in (
  7102	   873	            (positive_report, "positive corpus"),
  7103	   874	            (restraint_report, "restraint corpus"),
  7104	   875	        ):
  7105	   876	            if file_sha256(Path(report["path"])) != report["sha256"]:
  7106	   877	                raise RuntimeError(f"{label} changed before manifest publication")
  7107	   878	        if file_sha256(generator_path) != generator_sha:
  7108	   879	            raise RuntimeError("generator changed before manifest publication")
  7109	   880	
  7110	   881	    publish_bytes_exclusive(
  7111	   882	        output_manifest,
  7112	   883	        (
  7113	   884	            json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
  7114	   885	        ).encode("utf-8"),
  7115	   886	        before_link=verify_before_manifest_link,
  7116	   887	    )
  7117	   888	    print(json.dumps({
  7118	   889	        "manifest": str(output_manifest),
  7119	   890	        "manifest_sha256": file_sha256(output_manifest),

  7150	   100	    "normalize_embeddings": True,
  7151	   101	    "max_seq_length": 32768,
  7152	   102	    "comparison_axes": ["input_input", "output_output", "input_output", "output_input"],
  7153	   103	    "score_decimals": 6,
  7154	   104	    "top_k": 5,
  7155	   105	    "runtime_versions": {"sentence_transformers": "5.6.0", "transformers": "5.12.1", "torch": "2.12.1", "numpy": "2.4.6"},
  7156	   106	}

  7159	   109	class EmbeddingBackend(Protocol):
  7160	   110	    runtime_versions: dict[str, str]
  7161	   220	        path = Path(raw_path).expanduser().resolve()
  7162	   221	        if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():
  7163	   222	            raise ValueError(f"missing {label}: {key}")
  7164	   223	        result[key] = path
  7165	   224	    return result

  7168	   227	def extract_texts(rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[str]:
  7169	   228	    fields = ("asr_input", "gold_output", "input", "output", "expected_output")
  7170	   229	    return [value for row in rows for field in fields if isinstance((value := row.get(field)), str) and value.strip()]
  7171	   230	
  7172	   231	
  7173	   232	def text_sides(rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], role: str) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
  7174	   233	    if role == "benchmark":
  7175	   234	        input_fields, output_fields = ("asr_input",), ("gold_output",)
  7176	   235	    elif role in RAW_ROLES:
  7177	   236	        input_fields, output_fields = ("asr_input", "input"), ("expected_output", "gold_output", "output")
  7178	   237	    else:
  7179	   238	        return [], []
  7180	   239	    inputs = [value for row in rows for field in input_fields if isinstance((value := row.get(field)), str) and value.strip()]
  7181	   240	    outputs = [value for row in rows for field in output_fields if isinstance((value := row.get(field)), str) and value.strip()]
  7182	   241	    return inputs, outputs
  7183	   242

  7185	   244	def token_ngrams(value: str, width: int) -> set[tuple[str, ...]]:
  7186	   245	    tokens = v2.normalize_text(value).split()
  7187	   246	    return {tuple(tokens[index:index + width]) for index in range(max(0, len(tokens) - width + 1))}
  7188	   247	
  7189	   248	
  7190	   249	def character_ngrams(value: str, width: int) -> set[str]:
  7191	   250	    normalized = v2.normalize_text(value)
  7192	   251	    return {normalized[index:index + width] for index in range(max(0, len(normalized) - width + 1))}
  7193	   252	
  7194	   253	
  7195	   254	def jaccard(left: set[Any], right: set[Any]) -> float:
  7196	   255	    if not left and not right:
  7197	   256	        return 0.0
  7198	   257	    if not left or not right:
  7199	   258	        return 0.0
  7200	   259	    return len(left & right) / len(left | right)
  7201	   260	
  7202	   261	
  7203	   262	def pairwise_jaccard_stats(candidates: Sequence[str], references: Sequence[str], *, width: int, characters: bool, threshold: float | None) -> tuple[float, int | None]:
  7204	   263	    builder = character_ngrams if characters else token_ngrams
  7205	   264	    candidate_sets = [builder(value, width) for value in candidates]
  7206	   265	    reference_sets = [builder(value, width) for value in references]
  7207	   266	    maximum = 0.0
  7208	   267	    violations = 0
  7209	   268	    for left in candidate_sets:
  7210	   269	        for right in reference_sets:
  7211	   270	            score = jaccard(left, right)
  7212	   271	            maximum = max(maximum, score)
  7213	   272	            if threshold is not None and score >= threshold:
  7214	   273	                violations += 1
  7215	   274	    return maximum, violations if threshold is not None else None
  7216	   275	
  7217	   276	
  7218	   277	def cosine_stats(candidates: Sequence[str], references: Sequence[str], backend: EmbeddingBackend, threshold: float | None) -> tuple[float, int | None]:
  7219	   278	    if not candidates or not references:
  7220	   279	        return 0.0, 0
  7221	   280	    preflight = getattr(backend, "preflight_token_lengths", None)
  7222	   281	    if callable(preflight):
  7223	   282	        preflight(candidates)
  7224	   283	        preflight(references)
  7225	   284	    left = backend.encode_documents(candidates)
  7226	   285	    right = backend.encode_documents(references)
  7227	   286	    scores = np.clip(left @ right.T, -1.0, 1.0)
  7228	   287	    return float(np.max(scores)), (int(np.count_nonzero(scores >= threshold)) if threshold is not None else None)
  7229	   288	
  7230	   289	
  7231	   290	class SyntheticEmbeddingBackend:
  7232	   780	            raise ValueError(f"source receipt binding is stale: {key}")
  7233	   781	        if entry.get("producer_receipt_sha256") != sha256_bytes(get(receipt_path)):
  7234	   782	            raise ValueError(f"source inventory receipt hash is stale: {key}")
